name: The Big Bang Theory
overview: Scripture clearly affirms that God is the sovereign Creator of all things, having made the heavens and the earth at the beginning of time (Genesis 1:1). The creation account emphasizes God's deliberate and powerful act of bringing light and all creation into existence within six days, culminating in His rest and sanctification of the seventh day (Genesis 1:3; Exodus 20:11). Isaiah further reveals God's authority in stretching out the heavens and giving life to all people, underscoring that the vast universe and everything within it are under His command and care (Isaiah 42:5; Isaiah 45:12). This biblical foundation stands distinct from naturalistic explanations, affirming God as the purposeful originator of all things.
